description: A radio button lets users pick exactly one option from a set — shown on its own, as a labeled field, or in a titled group.

mapping.note: States: Enabled → default, Focused → :focus (CSS), Invalid → state="invalid", Warning → state="warning", Read-Only → state="read-only", Disabled → disabled, Skeleton → state="skeleton"

notes: The row holding the radio and its text is a <label>, so clicking the text selects the radio.
A focus style exists in Figma, but the generic element is not focusable; it shows only when forced (data-force-state="focus") until behaviour is specified.

sections.heading: Radio
paragraphs: A radio button lets users pick exactly one option from a set — shown on its own, as a labeled field, or in a titled group.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Radio is built as three layered components, from atom to organism. Only one radio in a group can be selected at a time.

sections.heading: Components
paragraphs: A control with its value text and optional error or warning row.
The circle alone — outer ring and inner dot. No label.
A group label with RadioFields, vertical or horizontal.

sections.heading: Selection
paragraphs: The inner dot shows the chosen option.

sections.heading: Anatomy
paragraphs: •   ① Control — a RadioControl instance: outer circle, inner dot when selected, focus ring when focused.
•   ② Value — the option's own text.
•   ③ Status icon — error or warning icon, shown in the Invalid and Warning states.
•   ④ Message — the error or warning text.
In a RadioGroup, a group label sits above the fields.

sections.heading: Alignment
paragraphs: Fields stack under the group label.

sections.heading: Main elements
paragraphs: •   Required on every RadioGroup — names the choice being made.
•   Text with a status icon, shown in the Invalid and Warning states.

sections.heading: States
paragraphs: Selecting a radio clears the other radios in its group. Read-only only ever shows an option that's already selected — it displays a prior choice, so there is no read-only radio with nothing selected.
•   RadioControl — Enabled, Hovered, Focused, Pressed, Disabled, Skeleton, Read-Only, Invalid, Warning; each Selected or not.
•   RadioField — Enabled, Focused, Invalid, Warning, Read-Only, Disabled, Skeleton.
See the Style tab for how each state looks.

sections.heading: Interactions
paragraphs: Moves between options in the group
Moves between options in the group
Full keyboard details are on the Accessibility tab.

sections.heading: Related
paragraphs: •   List item — uses RadioControl as its control for single-select lists.
•   Checkbox — the equivalent control for multi-select lists.

sections.heading: Color
paragraphs: RadioControl tokens per state, from the component.radio collection. Swatches are bound to the live tokens.
Focused adds a ring bound to color/focus-ring. The outer circle fill isn't bound to a token.

sections.heading: Typography
paragraphs: Text isn't bound to typography tokens yet (raw values).

sections.heading: Radio
paragraphs: A radio button lets users pick exactly one option from a set — shown on its own, as a labeled field, or in a titled group.

sections.heading: What the design system provides
paragraphs: •   A Focused state with a focus ring on the control.
•   Invalid and Warning states with a text message and icon, not color alone.

sections.heading: Development considerations
paragraphs: •   Each option uses role="radio" (or a native radio) with aria-checked.
•   Wrap the options in role="radiogroup", labelled by the group label.
•   Only one option in a group can be checked.
•   Disabled radios must not receive keyboard focus.

sections.heading: Design recommendations
paragraphs: Automated contrast check — WCAG 2.x relative luminance (sRGB), against the page surface (surface/bg/default), for every theme combination. Minimums: 3:1 for the circle, dot and focus ring (non-text UI), 4.5:1 for text. Values are before the Disabled opacity is applied. Note: project-a / light is measured against the current surface/bg/default, which resolves to blue because of the gray/50 token.

sections.heading: Target size
paragraphs: The control frame is 28px — above the 24×24px AA minimum but below the 44×44px touch target in the component rules. Make the value text part of the clickable area.
